issues.title: Channel row are generated when switch channel
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
In Channels tab, some rows are auto generated when we switch from one channel to another channel

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
 
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Login app as admin
2. Create a new game 
3. From 'Forces' tab, create some forces ( White, Blue, Red)
4. From 'Channels' tab, create channel 1 with some participant rows > Save Channel
5. Create channel 2 with some participant row > Save Channel
6. Switch from channel 1 and channel 2, notice the rows are auto generated

More details from below screencast : 

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
No more row is generated when switch from channels
